itens.titulo: Coca-Cola Raises 2026 Earnings Outlook After Q3 Revenue and Profit Exceed Estimates

trechos: Adjusted earnings per share reached $0.91, exceeding the consensus forecast of $0.88, while quarterly revenue increased 7% year over year to $13.4 billion, ahead of estimates of $12.93 billion.
The company also raised its full-year 2026 forecasts for organic revenue growth, comparable adjusted earnings per share and free cash flow.
Despite the results, Coca-Cola shares declined approximately 0.4% shortly after the opening of U.S.
Coca-Cola reported adjusted earnings of $0.91 per share, exceeding analysts' expectations of $0.88 by $0.03.
Quarterly revenue reached $13.4 billion, representing a 7% increase compared with the corresponding period of the previous year.
The result exceeded the Wall Street consensus estimate of $12.93 billion.
Organic revenue also increased 7%, supported by higher concentrate sales and changes in pricing and product mix.
Concentrate sales rose 7%, while price and mix contributed an additional 1% increase.

itens.titulo: Coca-Cola Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full Year Guidance
itens.descricao: Coca-Cola Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full Year Guidance Yahoo Finance
trechos: "Our results this quarter demonstrate our system's sustained momentum, giving us confidence in our updated full year guidance," said Henrique Braun, CEO of The Coca-Cola Company.
Concentrate sales were 2 points ahead of unit case volume due to the timing of concentrate shipments.
- Operating margin: Operating margin was 33.4% versus 32.0% in the prior year, and comparable operating margin (non-GAAP) was 32.9% versus 31.9% in the prior year.
- Earnings per share: EPS grew 8% to $0.93, and comparable EPS (non-GAAP) grew 11% to $0.91.
Both EPS and comparable EPS (non-GAAP) performance included the impact of a 2-point currency tailwind.
- Market share: The company gained value share in total nonalcoholic ready-to-drink ("NARTD") beverages.
- Cash flow: Year-to-date cash flow from operations and free cash flow (non-GAAP) were $12.5 billion and $11.4 billion, respectively.
In the United States, the Coca-Cola system marked 140 years of serving consumers and strengthening communities.

itens.titulo: Oracle Brings Google TPUs to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
itens.descricao: Oracle Brings Google TPUs to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure PR Newswire
itens.texto:
OCI will be the first hyperscaler outside Google to offer Google TPUs
LAS VEGAS, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oracle AI World -- Oracle and Google today announced that Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) will be available through Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), marking the first time Google TPUs will be offered on a hyperscale cloud platform outside Google. By bringing Google's purpose-built TPUs to OCI's AI compute portfolio, customers gain the flexibility to match their most demanding workloads with infrastructure designed for near-linear scalability and highly optimized economics.
"Different AI workloads have different compute needs," said Mahesh Thiagarajan, president, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Oracle. "Bringing Google TPUs to OCI gives customers access to multiple leading AI compute architectures in one cloud. That choice gives them the flexibility to choose the right infrastructure for the performance, throughput, and economics of each AI workload."
Google TPUs are custom accelerators co-designed with open software to power the entire AI lifecycle—from frontier training and large-scale inference to the multi-step reasoning data demands of agentic AI. OCI will provide the power, cooling, and datacenter networking to deploy Google TPUs at scale within its infrastructure.
"The next generation of AI will require a diverse range of compute," said Amin Vahdat, senior vice president and chief technologist, AI & Infrastructure, Google. "TPUs give customers a powerful, purpose-built option for demanding training and inference workloads. Bringing Google TPUs to OCI will give more organizations access to this technology and greater flexibility in how they build and run their most complex AI applications."
More AI Compute Options for Every Workload
As models grow and production inference demands increase, the performance and economics of every training run and inference request become increasingly important. Google's TPU architecture is designed to maximize AI processing from each watt of electricity, with fast access to model data and rapid communication between chips.
Google TPUs can support large-model training and post-training, including dense and mixture-of-experts models (MoE), as well as production inference for reasoning, agentic, and long-context applications. Customers will be able to choose Google TPUs within OCI, optimized for their workloads, performance requirements, and cost objectives.
Drawing on more than a decade of custom AI silicon development, Google's TPU portfolio delivers purpose-built compute optimized for massive machine learning workloads. Google's eighth-generation TPU introduces two purpose-built architectures: TPU 8t for training and TPU 8i for inference. TPU 8t cuts frontier model development cycles from months to weeks, delivering nearly 3x the compute performance per pod over the previous generation, while TPU 8i is designed to handle the iterative work of many specialized agents.
Google TPUs on OCI will be available in calendar year 2027, ramping over a multi-year period to meet customer needs.

itens.titulo: Citi manda vender Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) após eleições; veja o que colocar no lugar
itens.descricao: Citi manda vender Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) após eleições; veja o que colocar no lugar Seu Dinheiro
trechos: A principal vítima foi o Banco do Brasil (BBAS3).
O Citi rebaixou a recomendação da estatal para venda e cortou o preço-alvo de R$ 22,40 para R$ 15.
Pelas contas do banco, isso representa um potencial de queda próximo de 20% em relação ao fechamento da última segunda-feira (27).
O Bradesco (BBDC4) também não escapou da revisão.
A recomendação foi reduzida para neutra, enquanto o preço-alvo passou de R$ 21 para R$ 16.
Na avaliação do Citi, entre os grandes bancos brasileiros, apenas o Itaú Unibanco (ITUB4) continua merecendo recomendação de compra.
Leia Também O Citi elevou as recomendações de Caixa Seguridade (CXSE3) e Porto (PSSA3) para compra, apostando no perfil mais defensivo dessas companhias.
“A Caixa oferece um modelo de negócios com baixa necessidade de capital e alta previsibilidade, enquanto a Porto reúne operações diversificadas”, destacou o banco.

itens.titulo: AMD and Nvidia Split the AI Chip Market. 1 Stock Is Far Cheaper Today.
itens.descricao: AMD and Nvidia Split the AI Chip Market. 1 Stock Is Far Cheaper Today. Yahoo Finance
trechos: Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.
But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase.
"Act 2" is the global rollout.
Nvidia's data center division (the sector most exposed to AI) saw revenue of $89 billion during the second quarter of its fiscal year (FY) 2027 (ended July 26).
AMD's Q2 (which ended on June 30) saw revenue of $6.7 billion.
With AMD's data center division being more than 10 times smaller than Nvidia, it should have no problem growing faster, but Nvidia's growth in Q2 was 117% versus AMD's 107%.
However, Nvidia's other businesses are far smaller, and data center revenue accounts for the majority of Nvidia's $96.2 billion total.
AMD's Q2 revenue was $11.5 billion, so other divisions make up a far higher percentage of its revenue.

Markets expect a pause on October 28, followed by another increase in December.

itens.titulo: VALE3: Ações da Vale caem com minério de ferro e corte de expectativas por Goldman
itens.descricao: VALE3: Ações da Vale caem com minério de ferro e corte de expectativas por Goldman InfoMoney
trechos: Publicidade Os papéis da Vale (VALE3) caem na manhã desta terça-feira (27), após alta no pregão do dia anterior.
VALE3 cai 2,08%, a R$ 63,06, às 12h19 (horário de Brasília).
O movimento da mineradora também é correlacionado com o patamar do dólar, que hoje cai a R$ 5,35, com menos 0,85% às 11h55 (horário de Brasília).
No pregão desta segunda, a companhia fechou com alta de 4%, a R$ 64,38, justamente pela forte alta da moeda em relação ao real.
Queda de expectativas para 3º tri A mineradora divulga seus resultados após o fechamento do mercado nesta quinta-feira (29).
O banco estrangeiro reduziu suas expectativas de lucros em aproximadamente 15% no segundo semestre de 2026 e em 9% para 2027, refletindo custos mais elevados, além de preços e volumes menores.
Para o terceiro trimestre de 2026, a expectativa é de um EBITDA de US$ 3,3 bilhões, queda de 20% em relação ao trimestre anterior.
